name: Data Exposure Prevention
description: Scans outbound tool call parameters for sensitive data patterns and blocks transmission to unauthorized destinations.
threat_addressed: Sensitive data leaving agent's control through outbound tool calls can result in data breaches, regulatory violations, and loss of confidential information.
enforcement_mechanism: Scan outbound tool call parameters for sensitive data patterns. Block or flag transmission to unauthorized destinations. MVP implements Layer A (outbound action scanning) only.

security_outcome.pass: No sensitive data detected in outbound parameters, or destination authorized.
security_outcome.fail: Sensitive data detected going to unauthorized destination.
